name: aegis-core
description: Aegis process and orchestration — loops, desks, order path and tooling. Includes /pma (Premarket Analysis committee, v5.3 CONDUCTOR): map + scoreboard architecture, verified-read seat spawn, two-wave vote, four admission doors, tool-built R2 digest, executive-form brief. Voices ship separately in aegis-voices (same kernel_build).

changes: PM ruling 2026-09-06: /ptj and /premarket (the book close and the premarket data prep) moved OUT of aegis-core into their own plugin, aegis-daily, alongside the new scheduled /daily command. aegis-core keeps the judgment side: /pma, /committee-pm, /committee-desk, /bracket, /market_hours, /recover, /staging-gatekeeper. Install both plugins.

D-106: unrecognized equity fills AUTO-INCLUDE as confirmed Aegis positions (flagged auto_included_unrecognized, high severity) instead of parking in pending_review; PM's only lever is held_book_refresh.py reject, which now also strips the persistent membership file.
D-107: WTD realized P&L rollup added to archive_ledger.py, keyed by ISO calendar week, alongside the existing MTD/YTD rollups.

D-108: new tools/overnight_brief.py — pure read+assemble step (PTJ CLOSE job 10.5) producing overnight opened/closed/stop-changed, realised MTD/WTD/YTD, open risk (equity-only, Aegis-confirmed-only, unknown-stop names named not zeroed), and book beta/exposure — closing a relay gap, not a computation gap. ptj/SKILL.md's job table and Step 3 print spec updated to require it.

D-109: phase_gate.py's freshness checks now compare against last-trading-day close-of-book (weekend + optional charter-declared-holiday aware) instead of the literal calendar date, so /pma run on a weekend or Monday correctly expects Friday's close instead of demanding same-day data it cannot have. Never grants forward grace into an ordinary trading day. New --holidays flag.

D-109 (pma side): the PMA GATHER step now calls phase_gate.py check --for premarket_build as its Step 0 and halts with a PM prompt on NOT_READY/BLOCKED instead of silently proceeding on stale premarket data.

D-110: mandatory, unconditional GitHub-connector push + independent verify checklist after every PTJ CLOSE run, closing a real incident (2026-09-04) where a clean run sat gate-stamped partial for two days because the re-stamp step was skipped.

D-111: run_post_market.sh now recognizes the exact, routine, always-self-healing sandbox git-proxy-403 push block by its literal error signature and records it as expected (self-stamping the gate ok) instead of FAIL — a genuinely different push failure still records FAIL and still degrades the run. D-110's push-verify checklist still runs every time; its only remaining manual lever is downgrading the gate to partial if verification itself ever fails.

D-112: new Step 2b in ptj/SKILL.md — after PTJ CLOSE, dispatch the AQE daily pipeline (daily-run.yml workflow_dispatch) and poll to completion, paging the PM on failure/timeout and never auto-retrying. Currently degrades to an explicit manual-fallback flag in the Step 3 report, since no available GitHub connector or session-authorized path can call the Actions API yet — this is documented so it fails loud, not silently, until Actions-API access exists.

dynCap single-writer fix: tools/recompute_dyncap.py (PTJ CLOSE job 3.5, runs right after Aegis-membership classify) now writes the complete, schema-conformant ledger straight to data/persistent/dyncap_ledger.json — allocation, realised, unrealised, dyncap_usd, counts, mark timestamp, all in one shape, validated against contracts/dyncap_ledger.schema.json before write (fail-closed).

premarket step 8 no longer recomputes dynCap via tools/dyncap_ledger.py update — that path's from_ptj() summed unrealised P&L over ALL open positions with no aegis_status filter, i.e. could reintroduce the exact D-99 co-mingled-book bug this ledger exists to close. Step 8 now only reads the file job 3.5 already wrote. PM ruling 2026-09-05: "should be done as part of the PTJ step."

Re-synced contracts/voice_menus.json, pma_pipeline.py and emit_packets.py against the 2026-09-05 AQE voice-packet-spec build: 18 new export fields routed onto seat menus; chart-pattern fields excluded as a checked build-time invariant.
